Name: Wish
Description: The most powerful magic-user spell: the caster speaks a wish and one ally benefits. Choose H)eal/cure, I)tem, S)pell or C)haracter improvement.
EffectDescription: H) Fully heals and cures one ally. I) Conjures any item. S) Conjures a scroll of any spell up to 8th level. C) Permanently raises one ability score by 1.
